question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Despise
solution:
The correct answer is "**Dislike**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meanings of the given and the marked words: 
 
 
• **Despise means to feel a strong dislike or contempt for someone or something**.(घृणा)

 
 
• ​Example: She despises the thought of failing.
 
 
 
• **Dislike is a synonym of despise, meaning to have a feeling of aversion or antipathy towards someone or something.**(नापसन्द)
 
 
• ​Example: I dislike being in such awkward situations.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, in this case, dislike is the most appropriate synonym of despise.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Treasure means to value or cherish something highly. (निधि सुरक्षित रखना)
 
• Desire means to strongly want or wish for something.(इच्छा)
 
• Like means to have a positive feeling towards someone or something.(पसंद)
